items.information: Registration Fee: Any requested changes to registration before the deadline will be honored. Your registration is not complete until your name shows up on the list. If you believe you paid and your name isn't showing up, please contact us and we will work it out. If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please contact us. If it is before October 21st, you are eligible for a refund for half of your fee on the condition that there is someone on the waitlist willing to take your spot. Attempting to file a chargeback for the registration fee will lead to being blacklisted from future WCA events. The registration fee will be $25 per competitor and there is a competitor limit of 175. Registration will open on July 23rd, 2017 at 7pm CST, and will close on October 21st, 2017 or when the competitor limit is reached. Competitors MUST register and pay online in order to compete. No at-the-door registrations or payments will be accepted. ALL SPECTATORS ARE WELCOME TO ATTEND FOR FREE.
